If they're not getting the grades that they want, but they start using your tool, and they start getting the A's that they need, well, guess what? They're going to keep using it. In some ways, you're, you're a painkiller for people because they have to, they have to take the test. That's not avoidable. It's not like, does Johnny want to read faster, right? In your case, like your setup is largely catered towards the use case of studying for this exam or whatever it is. Like something very specific of I have this task I want to do.
